scholarships.name: Telangana ePASS Postmatric Scholarships (RTF & MTF)
scholarships.description: Comprehensive tuition fee reimbursement (RTF) and maintenance fee (MTF) for eligible students of Telangana pursuing Intermediate, ITI, Polytechnic, Undergraduate, Postgraduate, and Professional degree courses.

benefits.reimbursement_tuition_fee: Up to 100% sanctioned tuition fee for eligible colleges

eligibility_criteria.source_reference: G.O.Ms.No.66 Social Welfare (Edn.2) Dept and Telangana ePASS Portal

scholarships.name: Telangana ePASS Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme
scholarships.description: Financial assistance to SC, ST, BC, and disabled students studying in classes 9 and 10 in government recognized schools across Telangana.
scholarships.administering_authority: Scheduled Castes Development & BC Welfare Departments, Government of Telangana

benefits.annual_grant: ₹3,500 to ₹4,500 per annum for stationery, books, and educational requisites

scholarships.name: Telangana Chief Minister Overseas Scholarship Scheme
scholarships.description: Financial grant awarded to meritorious SC, ST, BC, and Minority graduates from Telangana to pursue higher education (Master's and Ph.D.) abroad in top-ranking accredited international institutions.
scholarships.administering_authority: Minorities & Welfare Departments, Government of Telangana

benefits.overseas_grant: Up to ₹20,00,000 towards tuition fees and living expenses

scholarships.name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
scholarships.description: Central sector scholarship provided by the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, to support financially challenged, high-performing students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in recognized Indian universities.
scholarships.administering_authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India

benefits.graduation_benefit: ₹12,000 per annum for the first 3 years of undergraduate study
benefits.post_graduation_benefit: ₹20,000 per annum for postgraduate degree courses

eligibility_criteria.source_reference: National Scholarship Portal & Department of Higher Education Gazette

scholarships.name: PM YASASVI Central Sector Scheme Of Top Class Education In Schools & Colleges
scholarships.description: Scholarship awarded by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment for OBC, EBC, and DNT students studying in designated premier schools and top-tier institutions across India.
scholarships.administering_authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India

benefits.tuition_coverage: Full tuition fees up to ₹1,25,000 per annum for school students and ₹2,00,000 for higher education
benefits.living_allowance: Monthly living allowance and computer equipment assistance

eligibility_criteria.source_reference: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment Notification

scholarships.name: Post Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
scholarships.description: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities scheme to assist disabled students pursuing post-matric and higher studies in recognized institutions.
scholarships.administering_authority: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of India

benefits.maintenance_allowance: ₹900 to ₹1,600 per month depending on course level and day scholar/hosteller status

eligibility_criteria.source_reference: DEPwD Official Guidelines and National Scholarship Portal
